=== Carrier ScriptSig Decode Detail ===

Each carrier TX_R scriptSig contains 3 data pushes after the FLC1FULL/header pushes:
  Push 1 (≤520 bytes): First chunk of Falcon-512 public key (897 bytes total)
  Push 2 (≤520 bytes): Second chunk containing remainder of pk + start of signature
  Push 3 (≤520 bytes): Third chunk with remainder of signature (~660 bytes)
  Push 4: 6-byte redeemScript (OP_DROP×5 OP_TRUE = 757575757551)

Validation math:
  commitment = SHA256(public_key || signature)
  SPV extracts pk (897 bytes) and sig from carrier scriptSig
  Computes SHA256(pk || sig) → commitment hash
  Matches against OP_RETURN in TX_C: 6a24 FLC1 <32-byte commitment>
